history.p: "Frühlings-Botschaft" was meant for the German market. It was never published in Denmark. Alone the choice of a poem by Emanuel Geibel was controversial from a Danish point of view, as the latter during the first Schleswig War had opposed Denmark.

physDesc.physMedium: Written in ink. Paper: 16 staves. Paginated 1-27. One bifolio is cover with title page. Last page blank. On p. 1 Geibel's text in Emil Erslev's hand. After the final double bar-line dated: "Fine d. 9' August 1858." and Gade's musical signature.
